callouts.label: Mass Matters
callouts.detail: The more massive an object, the stronger its gravitational pull.

callouts.label: Distance Factor
callouts.detail: Gravity weakens with increased distance; an inverse square law.

callouts.label: Universal Force
callouts.detail: Everything with mass attracts everything else with mass across the universe.

callouts.label: Earth's Gravity
callouts.detail: Keeps us grounded, orbits planets, and dictates tides, influencing all.
